description: src/lib.rs:196 — The match path.last() { Some(c) => ..., None => { debug_assert!...; return Ok(false); } } construct handles a single interesting arm; Clippy pedantic flags this as collapsible. Replace with if let Some(c) = path.last() { ... } with the debug_assert!/return as an else branch or prior guard. Cleaner, idiomatic, and avoids the misleading implication that None is a real code path.
title: [rusty/pkix-path-builder] replace match-on-Option with if let in dfs()
